notes: PASS with one required adaptation. create_model() builds types at runtime and Graphiti accepts them. The blueprint's own example ontology (Person.attributes.name) COLLIDES with the reserved EntityNode field 'name' and Graphiti raises EntityTypeValidationError. Compiler rule: 'name' is the node's own name, so it is not emitted (kept as the platform identity alias); any other reserved collision is a compile error for the author. All compiled fields are Optional so one missing attribute cannot fail an extraction; 'required' is enforced by the platform validator. Type/edge names are checked against ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}$ and Graphiti's reserved labels/edges. The allowlisted-static-class fallback is NOT needed.
